decisions.decision: Preserve Loki stream labels and select common parsed JSON message fields
decisions.rationale: This retains filename streams and prevents VictoriaLogs v1.50 from assigning the missing-message default.

decisions.decision: Query from epoch start in connection diagnostics
decisions.rationale: This separates backend/query health from Grafana time-range selection.

decisions.decision: Parse Apache and Nginx access-log timestamps in Alloy
decisions.rationale: Offline access records must store source event time instead of ingestion time.

decisions.decision: Flush idle historical Loki chunks after five seconds
decisions.rationale: Loki accepted the 350-line fixture but skipped its old in-memory chunks during queries; the documented ingester lookback override did not alter single-binary query routing in the tested 3.7 release, while automatic idle flushing reliably made records visible.
VictoriaLogs already verified both backend health and its query path; adding the equivalent Loki command makes the operator workflow backend-neutral.

decisions.decision: Check Loki's service endpoint instead of startup-gated readiness
decisions.rationale: Loki 3.7.6 returned successful historical queries while `/ready` still reported its post-ring startup delay; `/services` plus a real LogQL query detects an available local backend without that false negative.
